notes.title: GlitchSPANKR Update and News!
notes.notes:
As usual, we have the full scoop at our Newsletter ([url=https://www.theclassifiedx.com/newsletter]here[/url]), but we'll post an abridged version here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822260/2e901d99fe675d6461501f404c713fbce313ce29.jpg[/img]

[h1]GlitchSPANKR Hits 7,000 Wishlists & Indie Showcase![/h1]

We’re honored to announce that GlitchSPANKR was featured in the Six One Indie Showcase! Yes, someone watched our new trailer, saw Spunk’s face, and still said: “Yeah, this belongs here.” Huge thanks to the showcase team and everyone who checked it out. It was a treat to see the confused expressions of everyone watching the showcase suddenly get slapped with our trailer after a bunch of serious game trailers. Thankfully, most people seemed to be interested by the time our trailer ended. 

Oh, and we hit 7,000 wishlists. That’s 7,000 people preparing their spanking hands, hungry to play some Big Booty Slapper 6. I just hope there's BBS6 left to play by the time Spunk is done eating it.

New Trailer:
[previewyoutube=1DQW5Yw8sVA;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]

Steam Next Fest is just around the corner!
If you’ve enjoyed what you’ve played so far, tell your friends, your favorite creators, or just yell “GLITCHSPANKR” at the sky. The more eyes we get, the more Steam boosts the game... and that means more chaos for everyone. If the game does well, we even have some holiday DLCs planned, or even a VR version!

Originally set for late Q2, we're now pushing launch to mid-August 2025. Why? Because the game’s growing bigger than Spunk’s ego. More levels, more jokes, more hidden horrors. We want your first playthrough to hit hard, and we need just a little more time to make sure it does.

We've also been adding a whole second layer to the story through hidden levels, building out the "real" story of GlitchSPANKR. It's sad, it's dark, it's moving. It all builds up to the ultimate ending, all ties to that creepy door in SPANKR HQ.



[b]Good news[/b]: We'll be launching with a discount. Thanks for being patient, it’s going to be worth it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822260/ae0a7bf4c302329188b815e15fe320e1b07106ad.jpg[/img]

[b]New Stuff Sneak Peek[/b]
Between the chaos, we’ve been adding all sorts of weirdness:
- Adopt a glitchy pet at HQ
- Play Spunk Ball
- Hit the carnival, with several games to win prize tokens
- Dodge some death blades
- Maybe learn French? We’re not even sure anymore, Spunk's gone mad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822260/ff0ec7345e6650201a154eb157bb93fbeccd3b85.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822260/c93f5d50d2d23c0b143c962cdb71a668c0806846.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Small fixes and update on progress!
notes.notes:
🎪 [b]PATCHED & PETTED![/b] 🎪
Hey Spankrs! 
Just a tiny patch this time. Some bugs got squashed like digital roaches beneath the almighty Spank Stick. You might not feel the changes, but Spunk assures you: they hurt him deeply. Emotionally. As is our right, and dare I say, our duty. 

Quick News! We're part of the upcoming Six One Indie Showcase Steam Festival! 

Now onto JUICY JUICY SNEAKS! We’re saving the meatiest reveals for our [url=https://www.theclassifiedx.com/newsletter]Newsletter[/url], but here’s some carnival chaos for your corrupted eyeballs:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822260/399333c356121f945ecedbd44a7f3c3ac92a5dfd.jpg[/img]
Ever wished you could take Spunk on a date to a beautiful carnival to look deep in his angry, angry eyes? No? WELL TOO BAD, IT’S HAPPENING.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822260/aa22f2c7a286f396a71ee0764476aac31bcc6321.jpg[/img]

And what about that pet bowl in the SPANKR HQ? What's with that? Well, let me give a hint!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822260/891f6b729cb161f0200164bf0baaa1e3dd8b1cec.png[/img]

That's right, Pets are officially added to the game! They're ugly and broken (Spunk made them after all), but we'll try to fix what Spunk broke by launch. His pets are a little... odd.


There's plenty more! Dozens of levels! But I shan't spoil them for you, not yet! If you do like being pampered, spoiled, and granted in game gifts, feel free to join Our Newsletter link above!

notes.title: Special Valentine's Update
notes.notes:
Heyo Spankers!

I'm here to explain some new changes and updates. You can get the full list in depth explanation of changes and in game rewards with our monthly Newsletter [url=https://www.theclassifiedx.com/newsletter]Found Here[/url], but I'll give a quick rundown!

[b]Demo Changes[/b]
A few levels have been revamped as they felt a little boring. This includes the "Excited" and "Clubbing" level. Various other levels have been tweaked or upgraded with new art styles as well!

Different quality of life things have been added, such as allowing pausing/settings in the bedroom, adding the ability to skip Spunk's dialog with Q, redesigning secret areas to help catch the eye, and adding more intractables to play with.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822260/0549f51f83d08ac117864adb4ee44664beb82659.jpg[/img]

The bigger change is the WIP addition of a Fan Art Gallery in the SPANKR H.Q.! It should be out next week and it will have a museum style location featuring each piece of fan art, Patreon reward submitted 3D models, Discord contest winners, content creator easter eggs, and Newsletter Subscriber art submissions. 

Each "art installation" will showcase the art/model/Spank stick piece and the creators name and possible note. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822260/802dbefc912c47f1f274b67a5457d8068949bd07.jpg[/img]

That's all for now! The full Newsletter goes more in-depth (spoiler free) showing sneak peeks of various new levels, characters, and mechanics. This month even has a special Valentine's Day Spank stick with exclusive heart effects (so fancy!), along with how to get your grandparents IN GAME!

Next week will also have some updates and expansions to the demo, so stay tuned!

-Mahelyk

notes.title: GlitchSPANKR Demo QoL and Bug Fixes 11/25
notes.notes:
After watching some LetsPlays and Twitch Streams we've compiled a list of things we've fixed or improved!

-Added money pop-up animation to booty defense
-Added tower refund (half cost returned) 
-Added a face to a guy in the smoochie level
-Fixed a bug where you could pause in the collectible screen, exiting pause removed the mouse
-Fixed small ledge you could get stuck on in demonic level
-Change bedroom light switch to say E to Toggle Light Switch
-The end of the secret scary ending takes players to HQ instead of the bedroom
-Fixed up BBS6 menu to be more legible and less confusing
-Renamed HOME to SPANKR HQ to avoid confusion of people thinking the HQ was the bedroom
-Added a TIP to the win screen to help point people to the HQ and level selector
-Made glass more visible
-Checked if Pucker Puncher was broken from a letsplay I saw, unable to recreate issue, so hopefully
-Added numbers to all sliders in settings menu to make it easier
-Reinstall game button now also resets player's stick customization
-Drastically reduced the time forcing the player to listen to Spunk in the museum level before it opens, and in the Moral Dilemma level before the portal door opens.
-Changed club to start dance by spanking block instead of walking in area (should reduce accidental starts of song) 
-Probably a few other things I forgot to write down, let's just call them "Mystery Fixes" so it's fancy

As always, we'd love to hear feedback (good and bad) so we can improve the demo even more as we work on the full game!

notes.title: Hotfix 11/12/24

-Had a request about the Spank Sticks whistling sound when moving. For now there is a setting in the menu to lower the volume for the whistle and spank effects while we work on the wiggling movement.
